subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` become the supported plugin contract that lets core suppress live text and own fallback delivery?
rationale: This adds a plugin-facing behavioral contract and changes Telegram's default final-mode TTS presentation, so permanent API and product ownership cannot be established by test coverage alone.

options.title: Approve the capability
options.body: Keep the typed capability and Telegram opt-in after the cancellation defect is fixed and upgrade behavior is proven.

options.title: Narrow to Telegram
options.body: Implement the caption behavior through a Telegram-owned supported seam without exposing a general plugin capability yet.

options.title: Defer bundled captions
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers resolve the bundled-versus-separate delivery choice tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42539.

recommendation.title: Approve the capability
recommendation.body: Keep the typed capability and Telegram opt-in after the cancellation defect is fixed and upgrade behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing channel TTS capability resolver and surrounding contract most directly trace to this person's merged work.
